summary.text: Jim Qualey is a Republican state representative from Cheshire District 18 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where he has served since December 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him as an engineer with a Ph.D. in physics.

paragraphs.text: Jim Qualey lives in Rindge, New Hampshire, and earned a Ph.D. in physics from Pennsylvania State University.
His career experience includes working as an engineer in civilian and defense-related research and development and as a visiting professor of physics at Daniel Webster College.
Qualey assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 7, 2022, and Ballotpedia lists him as a member of the Election Law Committee for 2021-2022 and 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Cheshire 18, a two-seat district.
